title: OrchestrationTemplateSchema
description: Defines an Orchestration Template, as accepted by POST /api/v1alpha1/orchestration-definitions. One Orchestration Definition is created for each orchestration type in activities

id.description: ID of the template, generated if omitted. The created definitions refer to it as templateRef

schema.description: JSON Schema of the orchestration manifest payload

activities.description: Maps an orchestration type to the activities of an orchestration of that type

compensation.description: Maps an orchestration type in activities to the orchestration type in activities that is started when an orchestration of the first type fails

type.description: Type of an activity definition of the same namespace

NamespaceType.description: Optional. Must be the namespace of the request if given
